archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with elements of Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for B2B flows
design_philosophy: Fortune 500 Fintech standard. Capital, conviction, and premium trust. We are replacing generic purple/white SaaS templates with a cinematic, moody, and highly authoritative visual language. The design must project exclusivity (private 48-hour reverse auction) while maintaining strict functional clarity for numbers and data.

background.description: Deepest void tinted with indigo. NOT pure black.

surface.description: Subtle elevation using rich dark purple undertones.

primary.description: Deep Purple. Used for large structural accents, gradients, and brand moments.

accent.description: Emerald Green. The 'Money/Success' color. Use strictly for primary CTAs, LANE_1 trust chips, and live savings numbers.

secondary.description: Deep Blue. Used for secondary actions, LANE_2 chips, and technical/trust pillars.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to breathe luxury.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4CAF50] text-black font-semibold rounded-none px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#5ED162] transition-colors flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white font-medium rounded-none px-8 py-4 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

cards.marketing: bg-[#0D0817] border border-white/10 p-8 rounded-xl shadow-2xl
cards.pricing: relative bg-gradient-to-b from-[#120B1F] to-[#05030A] border border-white/10 p-10 rounded-2xl. Use 'Tracing Beam' concept for the $499 flat tier.
cards.b2b_panel: flat background, sharp edges, 1px border border-white/10, no shadow. Density over decoration.

header.style: fixed w-full z-50 bg-[#05030A]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5

chips.LANE_1: bg-[#4CAF50]/10 text-[#4CAF50] border border-[#4CAF50]/20 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1 rounded-sm
chips.LANE_2: bg-[#1565C0]/10 text-[#1565C0] border border-[#1565C0]/20 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1 rounded-sm
chips.LANE_3: bg-white/5 text-white/70 border border-white/10 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1 rounded-sm

motion.entrance: opacity-0 translate-y-4 to opacity-100 translate-y-0 duration-700 ease-out
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis is MANDATORY.

image_urls.description: Sleek dark Land Rover in studio lighting. Use with heavy bg-black/60 overlay and a radial gradient to ensure text readability.
Professional handshake across table. Apply deep blue/purple duotone filter or heavy dark overlay.
Green glowing particles on dark background representing the 3-level commission tree.
Abstract 3D render with gradient curves. Dark and elegant.
Glass object with dark blue background representing security and trust.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and setup @phosphor-icons/react for duotone/premium iconography.
Use framer-motion for page transitions and entrance animations.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Select and Calendar, heavily styled to match the dark theme.
All real numbers (Savings, Dealers, Buyers) must use the mono font (JetBrains Mono) for a 'fintech dashboard' feel.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or placeholder images. Use the provided image_urls and write confident, real-sounding copy.
